description: A script for identifying missing translations in locale files, including functions for reading, validating, and comparing translation JSON files across different areas and locales.

methods.name: findKeys
methods.description: Recursively finds all keys in a nested object, returning dotted paths.

methods.name: getValueAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an object given a dotted path string.

methods.name: parseJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file, with error handling.

methods.name: validateFlatStructure
methods.description: Ensures a JSON object has a flat structure (no nested objects).

methods.name: checkAreaTranslations
methods.description: Checks translation files within a specified area for missing keys.

methods.name: outputResults
methods.description: Outputs the missing translation report for a given area.

methods.name: checkPackageNlsTranslations
methods.description: Checks the package.nls.json files for missing translations.

methods.name: outputPackageNlsResults
methods.description: Outputs the missing translations report for package.nls files.

methods.name: findMissingTranslations
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the overall missing translation check process.
